instruction: Copy the image from the .xcf file on the Desktop, paste it into a LibreOffice Writer document with the title 'Cat Photo' above it, and save as 'photo_doc.docx' on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened .xcf file in GIMP, used Edit > Copy Visible to copy the image, launched LibreOffice Writer via Activities search, pasted the image with Ctrl+V, and saved the document as image.docx on the Desktop via File > Save As dialog.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open XCF files in GIMP, navigate GIMP menus, copy visible layers, launch applications via Activities, paste images into LibreOffice Writer, use Save As dialog to save in .docx format on Desktop
metadata.task_rationale: A harder variation of the original task. The model proved it can copy from GIMP and paste into Writer. This adds the requirement to type a title above the image before saving, testing text editing alongside image pasting in a cross-app workflow.
metadata.explanation: Task requires the same GIMP-to-Writer workflow as the original, plus typing a title. Custom getter extracts text and image count from the saved .docx. Custom metric gives 0.5 for title text present and 0.5 for image embedded, enabling partial credit.

scoring_breakdown.image_present: 0.5 - Document contains at least 1 embedded image

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the .docx file from the expected path (/home/user/Desktop/photo_doc.docx), extracts paragraph text and counts embedded images via word/media/ zip entries.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('expected_text') and expected.get('min_images') without incorrectly nesting into expected['rules'].
Partial credit scoring (0.5 for text, 0.5 for image) is well-designed and matches the two main requirements of the instruction.
Postconfig correctly activates the Writer window and saves the file before evaluation, ensuring fresh file state.

Minor gap: evaluator checks that 'Cat Photo' text exists in the document but does not verify it appears above (before) the image. This is a reasonable practical limitation since verifying spatial ordering in .docx paragraph structure would add complexity for marginal verification benefit.
File existence is implicitly verified - if the file doesn't exist, the getter returns an error dict and the metric returns 0.0.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: To strengthen verification, the getter could check paragraph ordering to confirm the 'Cat Photo' text appears before the image anchor in the document XML structure, ensuring the title is above the image as specified.
